decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive Elf tribe strategy. The deck utilizes various Elf creatures and mana-producing cards to quickly summon a large board presence. Cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling allow for efficient creature tutoring and instant speed responses. The deck also includes cards like Shaman of the Pack and Dwynen's Elite to deal direct damage and generate additional Elf tokens. The land base is optimized for mana production and consistency, ensuring a fast and consistent Elf onslaught.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through ramping up mana with Omnath, Locus of Creation and utilizing Bring to Light to find key cards. It also includes Chained to the Rocks for removal, Leyline Binding for disruption, and Slaughter Games for hand disruption. The deck includes a variety of lands for flexibility and consistency, as well as a mix of creatures and spells for versatility in different matchups. Overall, the deck aims to establish control over the game while ramping up its resources to dominate the battlefield.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly deploy low-cost creatures and apply pressure on the opponent, using cards like Thraben Inspector, Ornithopter, and Regal Leosaur to establish a strong board presence. The deck aims to maintain momentum and tempo, leveraging cards like Venerated Loxodon and Resolute Reinforcements to go wide and overwhelm the opponent efficiently. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds versatility and consistency to the deck's strategy. Overall, the deck's key concept is to aggressively push damage and control the battlefield through efficient creature plays and combat tricks.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of Retraction Helix with various cards to generate value and outpace the opponent. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Dig Through Time for disruption and card advantage, alongside creatures like Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and Fae of Wishes for additional threats, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of Zirda, the Dawnwaker as a companion allows for cost reduction and further enhances the deck's efficiency in executing its game plan.

The deck revolves around the key interaction between Lotus Field and various untap effects, allowing the player to generate a large amount of mana quickly. By tutoring for Lotus Field with cards like Sylvan Scrying and assembling the combo pieces, the deck aims to cast powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience to overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Dark Petition and Behold the Beyond provides additional consistency and card advantage. With the right setup and timing, the deck can execute its game plan efficiently and win through explosive combo turns.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly by utilizing Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, then use that mana to play powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn. The deck also includes cards like Oath of Nissa and Storm the Festival to help find key pieces, along with Karn, the Great Creator for additional utility. Lair of the Hydra provides a mana sink for extra resources, while Wolfwillow Haven helps with mana fixing. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Boseiju, Who Endures add additional support and protection. Invasion of Ixalan is the backup plan for closing out games if needed.

The deck focuses on assembling the Lotus Field combo using cards like Sylvan Scrying and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to find and untap the key land. Once Lotus Field is in play, the deck aims to generate huge amounts of mana with cards like Hidden Strings and Hidden Strings, eventually casting powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience to win the game. The deck also includes ways to interact with the opponent's game plan, like Lair of the Hydra and Boseiju, Who Endures, while utilizing card draw and tutoring effects to find the necessary pieces for the combo.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with a combination of Spirit creatures and tempo control. Utilizing cards like Rattlechains and Spell Queller to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building up a board presence with creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Shacklegeist. The goal is to maintain constant pressure on the opponent while protecting your own creatures with counter spells like Lofty Denial. The inclusion of cards like Curious Obsession and Spectral Sailor allow for card advantage and potential card draw, ensuring a steady stream of threats to overwhelm the opponent.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to establish a fast and aggressive board presence, utilizing low-cost creatures like Thraben Inspector and Burning-Tree Emissary to quickly put pressure on the opponent. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures, supported by powerful pump effects like Reckless Bushwhacker and Venerated Loxodon. The inclusion of cards like Embercleave and Castle Embereth provide additional ways to maximize damage output and push for a quick victory. Overall, the key strategy is to efficiently utilize efficient creatures and combat tricks to establish dominance on the battlefield and close out games swiftly.

This deck revolves around assembling the combo of Greasefang, Okiba Boss along with Parhelion II to generate value and overwhelm the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Liliana of the Veil, Thoughtseize, and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also utilizing cards like Grisly Salvage and Vessel of Nascency to find key pieces. The deck also includes powerful cards like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Esika's Chariot to further pressure the opponent and close out the game. Overall, the deck aims to set up its combo while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing various spells and abilities to create a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Secrets of the Key, Indomitable Creativity, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, the goal is to generate a strong board presence and deal significant damage to the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of countermagic, removal spells, and card draw helps to control the game and ensure the combo can be successfully executed. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and maximize efficiency.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with small, efficient creatures that can quickly build up a threatening board presence. By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant to disrupt the opponent's plans and boost the power of your army, along with cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Luminarch Aspirant to rapidly grow your forces, this deck aims to assert dominance on the battlefield early on and maintain pressure throughout the game. With a low mana curve and a focus on aggression, it seeks to win the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of the deck is to utilize green devotion and aggressive creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By using mana acceleration from cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, the deck can ramp up to powerful threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provide additional versatility and card advantage. The inclusion of Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Lair of the Hydra further supports the aggressive strategy, while cards like Oath of Nissa and Wolfwillow Haven help to ensure consistency in the deck.

This deck focuses on deploying evasive Spirit creatures and controlling the board with counter spells and removal. The goal is to quickly build a board presence and protect key creatures like Spell Queller and Shacklegeist. Curious Obsession allows for card draw and additional pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to maintain tempo by consistently attacking and disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Lofty Denial. Overall, the strategy relies on aggression and tempo to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with efficient creatures like Llanowar Elves and Skyclave Apparition, while also utilizing cards like Resplendent Angel and Righteous Valkyrie to gain life and pump up your creatures. Collected Company allows you to dig for more creatures and potentially flood the board with threats. The deck also includes powerful lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Sigarda, Font of Blessings to provide additional value and resilience against control decks. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a steady stream of aggressive creatures while gaining incremental advantages through lifegain and card advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up quickly using mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, as well as Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to generate massive amounts of mana. The deck utilizes green devotion to power up key cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Karn, the Great Creator is used to fetch key artifacts. Storm the Festival helps to dig for key creatures and spells, while cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Oath of Nissa provide additional ramp and card selection. Lair of the Hydra and Tribute to the World Tree provide additional utility and win conditions.
